moved.sentence: You **MUST** maintain a data map enumerating every place personal data lives:

judged.note: Maintaining a data map enumerating every place personal data lives is kept at MUST.

moved.sentence: Deletion **MUST** reach every derived copy, not just the primary row:

judged.note: Deletion reaching every derived copy, not just the primary row, is kept at MUST.

moved.sentence: Caches, search indexes, denormalized read models, and analytics aggregates.

judged.note: The four derived-copy kinds (caches, search indexes, denormalized read models, analytics aggregates) are kept under the same MUST.

moved.sentence: Third-party processors — call their deletion APIs and record completion.

judged.note: Deletion reaching third-party processors via their deletion APIs, with completion recorded, is kept at MUST.

moved.sentence: Logs and event streams: prefer pseudonymization or crypto-shredding (delete the per-subject key) where immutable append-only logs make row deletion impractical.

judged.note: Deletion reaching logs and event streams stays MUST, and preferring pseudonymization or crypto-shredding where append-only logs make row deletion impractical is kept at SHOULD with its condition.

moved.sentence: Backups: full purge is often infeasible; document the rotation window after which restored backups are re-scrubbed, and treat that window as part of the SLA.

judged.note: Backups are kept: full purge often infeasible, the re-scrub rotation window documented (now explicit MUST) and treated as part of the SLA.

moved.sentence: Authenticate against an existing session or a verified channel; **MUST NOT** disclose or delete data on an unverified claim, since the request itself is an attack surface for account takeover and data exfiltration.

judged.note: Authenticating against an existing session or verified channel is kept at SHOULD, and the MUST NOT on disclosing or deleting on an unverified claim is kept with its account-takeover and exfiltration reason.

moved.sentence: This is an architectural property, not a feature bolted on later: every store of personal data MUST be enumerable, exportable, and deletable keyed by a stable subject id.
> Engineering guidance only — NOT legal advice.

judged.note: The engineering-only, not-legal-advice disclaimer is kept in the counsel rule.

moved.sentence: Confirm rights, scope, exemptions, and deadlines with counsel for your jurisdictions.

judged.note: Confirming rights, scope, exemptions and deadlines with counsel for your jurisdictions is kept at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Track per-request SLA and alert before breach.

judged.note: Tracking per-request SLA and alerting before breach is kept at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Under GDPR Chapter 3 (and analogues such as CCPA/CPRA), an agent **MUST** be able to satisfy each request type:

judged.note: The GDPR Chapter 3 (and CCPA/CPRA) basis is kept in rationale, which names all six request-type rules, and each request type is its own MUST rule starting with access.
